'''Sammrie''' is a [[cooper]] in [[Hinderstap]]. 

==Activities==
Sammrie, his sister and her family, are trapped in the town of Hinderstap by a [[bubble of evil]]. His sister and her family were not originally trapped in the town, but after dying during the violence at night, they were drawn in as well.{{ref/book|12|28}}
